items.q: my cousin was named Elizabeth and she say, 'Yes, that's George all right,' said, 'because I knew him by that gold tooth that was in his mouth,'

ctx.x: Lord, I had to put him away and me nothing but a girl, you know. I say that liked to have killed me. That liked to have, with my Mama dead, now my brother's done died. I couldn't find nobody -- my sister was dead, too, my older sister. So my cousin went with me and so she came to Chicago with me. I was in Detroit. So she came to Detroit with me to help me along, because I couldn't have made it by myself, because I couldn't have made it. And she helped me. ________

my brother. Went to the morgue and (unintelligible) was cut off, you know. (Unintelligible) and so when they pulled that drawer out, and by being in that drawer, he got kind of light, you know, in there, and so -- my cousin was named Elizabeth and she say, "Yes, that's George all right," said, "because I knew him by that gold tooth that was in his mouth," eye tooth, (unintelligible) any kind of dental work in his mouth? And (unintelligible) and then . I didn't find Buddy's papers until about -- after he was dead…

whosomever it was that took his clothes left him one suit to be buried in _______ somebody that knew him, left him one suit to be buried in. I said, "Thank God you left him that," _______ a big tall man. (Unintelligible). All this is behind this "Bedroom Blues" tune. I said, "Well, I wish I did know what to do." But you know, I have made (unintelligible). And that's when I _______. All these things _______ stand by me because the Lord has sure stood by me and when I sing the blues -- let me show you something,…
